sloka: उचितेष्व् अपि सुव्यक्तम् न तासाम् योषिताम् तदा ।विवेकः शक्य आधातुम् भूषण अन्ग अम्बर स्रजाम् ॥५-९-६६॥
transliteration: uciteṣv api suvyaktam na tāsām yoṣitām tadā ।vivekaḥ śakya ādhātum bhūṣaṇa anga ambara srajām ॥5-9-66॥

translations.english: It was not possible to distinguish clearly between their jewels, limbs, garments and garlands and to place them in the right spots.
